__comment: Editable trusted services content. Arrays can be expanded with more tips, trusted badge details, and emergency contacts.

moneyExchange.title: Avoid airport exchange desks for large amounts
moneyExchange.description: Airport kiosks are convenient but often have weaker rates. Withdraw a small amount if needed, then compare central London options.

moneyExchange.title: Compare the total you receive, not just the headline rate
moneyExchange.description: Ask for the final amount after fees before handing over cash. A great-looking rate can be cancelled out by commission.

moneyExchange.title: Victoria and Marble Arch have many bureaux
moneyExchange.description: Tourist-heavy areas such as Victoria, Marble Arch, Queensway, and Edgware Road often have several exchange desks close together, making comparison easier.

moneyExchange.title: Use cards where possible
moneyExchange.description: London is highly card-friendly. Use contactless for transport and shops, and keep a little cash for markets or small stalls.

businesses.name: Hotel concierge desks
businesses.description: Good for restaurant bookings, luggage advice, theatre suggestions, and safe route planning late at night.

businesses.name: Official visitor information points
businesses.description: Use official desks and recognised venue staff for maps, accessibility advice, and event updates.

businesses.name: TAP LONDON Trusted Badge
businesses.description: Future partner businesses can display a TAP LONDON badge after review for tourist-friendly service, clear pricing, and helpful staff.

scamTips.title: Three-card trick and street gambling
scamTips.description: Avoid pavement games around bridges and busy squares. The crowd can be part of the setup and tourists are targeted.

scamTips.title: Fake charity clipboards
scamTips.description: Do not give card details to aggressive street collectors. Donate later through official charity websites if you want to support a cause.

scamTips.title: Unofficial ticket sellers
scamTips.description: Buy theatre, attraction, and event tickets from official sites, venue box offices, or recognised sellers.

scamTips.title: Pickpocket hotspots
scamTips.description: Keep phones and wallets secure around Oxford Street, Leicester Square, Camden, Westminster Bridge, and busy Tube platforms.

scamTips.title: Unlicensed minicabs
scamTips.description: Never accept rides from drivers approaching you in the street. Use black cabs, official taxi ranks, or licensed apps.

emergency.name: Police, Fire, Ambulance
emergency.description: Use for emergencies when someone is in immediate danger or a crime is happening now.

emergency.name: Non-emergency police
emergency.description: Use to report non-urgent crimes or seek police advice.

emergency.name: NHS medical advice
emergency.description: Use for urgent medical help when it is not a life-threatening emergency.

emergency.name: Tourist support placeholder
emergency.description: Placeholder TAP LONDON support line for WhatsApp assistance and partner enquiries.
